interface.signature: def numoffbt(arr: list[int], n: int) -> int:

preconditions.description: All integers in arr are greater than 1.
The size of arr is between 1 and 10^5 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(2 <= x <= 10**5 for x in arr)
preconditions.description: Each element in arr is between 2 and 10^5 (inclusive).

postconditions.description: The returned value is a non-negative integer representing the count of valid full binary trees modulo 1000000007.
The returned value equals the count of all valid full binary trees where each non-leaf node is the product of its children, modulo 1000000007.
